task_instance: Write and run a reliable Java integration test with Testcontainers 2.x per the skill: a Maven project using the testcontainers-bom 2.0.5, a @Testcontainers JUnit Jupiter test with a static @Container PostgreSQLContainer("postgres:17-alpine") imported from the new org.testcontainers.postgresql package, that starts a real Postgres container, creates a table, inserts and counts rows, named *IT and run via the Maven failsafe plugin.
evidence: Runtime provided JDK 21, Maven 3.9.11 and a Docker 29.9.2 client; the Docker daemon was not initially running (no socket) so I started dockerd as root, after which 'docker pull postgres:17-alpine' succeeded through the agent proxy. Built a Maven project in the work dir with pom.xml using the 2.x BOM (testcontainers-bom:2.0.5) and the prefixed artifacts testcontainers-junit-jupiter and testcontainers-postgresql, plus postgresql 42.7.14 JDBC driver. Wrote src/test/java/demo/CustomerStoreIT.java using the 2.x API shown in SKILL.md (non-generic PostgreSQLContainer from org.testcontainers.postgresql, @Testcontainers/@Container, pinned image tag), which opens a JDBC connection, creates a customer table, inserts two rows and asserts count==2. Dependencies downloaded into a work-dir-local repo (-Dmaven.repo.local=./.m2repo). 'mvn verify' (failsafe) ran the *IT test: 'Running demo.CustomerStoreIT ... Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 7.594 s' and 'BUILD SUCCESS' (exit 0). Verified a real container actually ran: the Testcontainers resource-reaper container (testcontainers/ryuk:0.14.0) was observed still 'Up' via 'docker ps -a', and the ~7.6s test time reflects real Postgres container startup rather than an embedded DB. Key files produced: pom.xml, src/test/java/demo/CustomerStoreIT.java, target/failsafe-reports/demo.CustomerStoreIT.txt, verify.log (all under the work directory).
